about_the_game:
◆Story

After returning home from work, you find your room has become completely unfamiliar...
This is an adult-oriented game inspired by the style of the “Find the Difference: Episode 8” series, where your goal is to identify anomalies and escape from a mysterious space.
Objects disappear, colors change, positions shift...
From subtle abnormalities to major changes — don’t miss a single one as you carefully investigate and move forward.
Sometimes, truly frightening things may happen... but gather your courage and push on.
When you're tired, let the mysterious woman "Maria," who sits on the sofa, comfort you.
As you progress through the game, she’ll begin to do more and more erotic things with you...

◆How to Play




After coming home from work, your room looks completely unfamiliar...
Find 8 anomalies in this mysterious game to return to your original world.



A mysterious beauty named "Maria" appears in your room.
When you're feeling tired, try talking to her.
She’ll probably do some erotic things to help you relax.



As you progress through the game, more interactions and features become available.
Enjoy spending time with Maria while taking on the eerie challenge of spotting strange anomalies.

content_descriptors.notes:
